  supported_documents: 5000+ types from 190+ countries
  nfc_verification: Reads embedded chips in e-passports and smart IDs
  forensic_tests: Over 180 forensic tests for forgery and tampering detection
  data_extraction: Automated extraction and authentication
  format_support: PDF scans and digital uploads
  real_time_detection: Forgeries and tampering detected in real-time

liveness_and_biometrics:
  liveness_detection: Both passive and active approaches
  passive_liveness: No user action needed
  active_liveness: Challenge-based liveness
  face_matching: Matches document photo to live selfie using NIST-rated algorithms
  deepfake_detection: AI-based techniques to spot AI-generated and synthetic identities
  synthetic_identity_detection: Identifies computer-generated identities

anti_fraud_capabilities:
  serial_fraud_monitor: Second layer of defense for fraud pattern monitoring
  coordinated_attack_detection: Identifies repeated fraudulent attempts and organized fraud
  consortium_validation: Shared intelligence for detecting repeat offenders
  cross_validation: Emerging threat pattern detection
  anomaly_detection: ML for document inconsistencies and suspicious behaviors
  real_time_analysis: Continuous monitoring and risk assessment

  deployment_options: Cloud and on-premises environments
  privacy: End-to-end encryption (transit and at rest)
  data_handling: Personal data not resold without permission
